> @copilot 仔细评估是否已经完成了任务中要求的所有开发

Evaluated all 8 requirements from the issue checklist. Items #4 (ConfigRow layout — label maxWidth, text ellipsis with overflow tooltip) and #7 (toolbar toggles merged into summary chip — "X of Y enabled") were missing. Both are now implemented in commit `33d65a5`.

**Updated status — all 8 items complete:**
1. ✅ Section spacing (`space-y-1`, `my-3`)
2. ✅ Progressive disclosure (`defaultCollapsed` on toolbar/navigation/records/appearance)
3. ✅ New `ControlType: 'summary'` (summaryText + gear icon)
4. ✅ ConfigRow layout optimization (label `max-w-[45%]` + truncate + title tooltip)
5. ✅ Section icon support
6. ✅ Subsections support
7. ✅ Toolbar summary chip ("X of Y enabled" chip + individual toggles when expanded)
8. ✅ View Schema adjusted as template
